title: {first} is homesick
text: It's his first winter away from {from}: short days, cold mornings, and no one here who knew him a year ago. He's quiet at training.

choices.label: Move him in with a host family

effects.why: You found him a host family when he was homesick

choices.result: {first} moves in with a family near the club. The first week is all boxes and a new bed.

choices.label: Fly a parent out

effects.why: You flew his parent out when he was homesick

choices.result: {first}'s mum lands on Thursday. The club pays the flights.

choices.label: Let him go home for a week

effects.why: You let him go home when he was homesick

choices.result: {first} flies home for a week.

title: {first} is still learning the game
text: He wins plenty of the ball, then gives it away: the umpire pings him for holding it, and the bounce off the turf keeps beating him. His old game never asked him to read an oval ball.
He keeps getting pinged for holding the ball, and the way the oval ball sits up still catches him out. The talent is there; the habits are another game's.

choices.label: Extra skills sessions
choices.result: {first} stays back with the skills coach each afternoon. He's tired, but he's learning.

choices.label: Play him in the reserves for a week
choices.result: {first} learns it against reserves players, with room to make mistakes.

choices.label: Back him and show him vision

effects.why: You backed him through his first mistakes and sat down with vision of them

choices.result: You sit down with the vision. {first} knows you're backing him.

title: {first} has played his first game
text: The papers back home in {from} have picked it up, and a broadcaster wants a word with him this week.

choices.label: Let him do the interviews
choices.result: {first} does the calls late at night to suit the time back home. He's flat at training.

choices.label: Keep it quiet for now

effects.why: You kept the media off him after his first game

choices.result: {first} stays out of the spotlight. He'd have liked to share it.

title: {first} has kicked his first goal
text: The clip is all over the news back in {from}, and his family have been sending photos from the lounge room.

choices.label: Make a night of it with the group
choices.result: The group takes {first} out for dinner. He's flat at the next session.

choices.label: Back to work on Monday
choices.result: {first} is back on the track on Monday. He'd wanted to celebrate it.

title: {first} wants to go home for the summer
text: It's been a long first season away from {from}. He's asked whether he can spend the break with his family.

choices.label: Ask him to stay for the summer program
choices.result: {first} stays. The summer block is a big one for a first-year player.

choices.label: Let him go home

effects.why: You let him go home for the summer after his first season

choices.result: {first} flies home for the break. The football department isn't thrilled he'll miss the summer block.

title: {home_club} want {first} back
text: It's championship time, and {home_club} have asked if he'll come home and play. He grew up on it.

choices.label: Let him go home for the championship

effects.why: You let him go home to play for his county

choices.result: {first} flies home to play for {home_club}.

choices.label: Release him for the final only

effects.why: You released him for his county's final

choices.result: {first} makes a quick trip home for the final and comes straight back. He's heavy-legged on Saturday.

choices.label: Tell him his contract is with us

effects.why: You told him no when his county wanted him home

choices.result: {first} stays. He's quiet about it.

title: {first} is torn about home
text: His deal ends this year, and the pull of {from} is real. He hasn't said yes or no.

choices.label: Offer him an early extension
Tell him to take the off-season to decide

effects.why: You gave him the off-season to decide about home

choices.result: {first} has until the end of the season. The board would rather it was settled.

title: {first}'s college coach is in town
text: His old college coach and his parents have flown in for the weekend, and a podcast back home wants to film a session.

choices.label: Welcome them to training

effects.why: You welcomed his college coach and family to training

choices.result: The coach watches from the fence. The cameras put the group off a little.

choices.label: Keep it to the weekend, away from the club

effects.why: You kept his visitors away from training

choices.result: {first} shows them around the city instead. He'd wanted them to see the club.

title: A rugby club has rung about {first}
text: A club back in {from} has offered him more money to come home and play rugby. His manager has told you.

choices.label: Offer him an early extension
Let him take the meeting

effects.why: You let him hear out a rugby offer

choices.result: {first} hears them out. Word gets round, and the board isn't happy.

choices.label: Tell him he's a footballer now

effects.why: You shut the door on a rugby offer without hearing it

choices.result: {first} nods. He doesn't say much.

title: A program back home wants {first}
text: The football program he came through in {from} wants him as its face: a video for the kids, and a clinic when he can get back.

choices.label: Say yes
choices.result: {first} films the message for the kids. The other young players notice who's getting the spotlight.

choices.label: Ask them to wait until he's established

effects.why: You asked him to put his home program off

choices.result: {first} sends a short note instead and keeps his head down.

title: {first}'s family can't get a visa
text: His debut is this week and his parents' visas haven't come through. They won't be in the stands.

choices.label: Have the club push the visas through

effects.why: You went to bat for his family's visas before his debut

choices.result: The club's staff spend the week on the phone. The visas arrive on Friday.

choices.label: Hold his debut back a week

effects.why: You held his debut back so his family could be there

choices.result: {first} waits a week. His family will be there.

choices.label: Set up a live stream and a call after the game

effects.why: You asked him to make do without his family at his debut

choices.result: {first} plays his debut without them. They watch on a phone in the kitchen.
